name: @disco/pi-kernel
description: Disco Pi Build Kernel — the inner-loop sidecar that embeds Pi with no built-in tools, in-memory auth/session, emitting a JSON line-protocol event stream over stdio (Disco Pi Build Kernel Campaign, EPIC B / PR B1).

scripts._install_policy: ENFORCEMENT POINT (campaign §1.2 — never run dependency lifecycle scripts): install ONLY via `npm run setup` (npm install --ignore-scripts), or in CI with `npm install --ignore-scripts`. The package-local .npmrc pins ignore-scripts=true as the default. The `preinstall` script below is a BEST-EFFORT advisory ONLY — it cannot guarantee a dependency script did not already run (it runs only when lifecycle scripts are enabled, and ordering is not guaranteed), so it must never be treated as the backstop.
scripts.preinstall: node -e "if(process.env.npm_config_ignore_scripts!=='true'){console.error('[@disco/pi-kernel] BEST-EFFORT WARNING (advisory, NOT a guarantee): this install did not disable lifecycle scripts. Campaign \u00a71.2 forbids running dependency scripts; the enforced path is `npm run setup` (npm install --ignore-scripts) or CI with --ignore-scripts. See .npmrc and the _install_policy note in package.json.')}"
